A place in Vellore to cool off.

Nimmis Swimming Pool is on Kalinjur Main Road in Katpadi, Vellore. The pool is surrounded by colourful steps and greenery, which makes it an easy place to spend a few hours in the water.

Come on your own, with friends, or with the whole family.

Rated 4.7 out of 5 by 653 people on Google

Facilities

  • Swimming pool

    A bright blue tiled pool with steps and rails to get in and out. See the photos in the gallery.

  • Locker facility

    Lockers are available for visitors to keep their belongings.

  • Shower facility

    Shower facilities are available for visitors.

  • Restrooms

    Restroom facilities are available on the premises.
